summary: Master digital file plan design and access control. Learn ISO 15489, RBAC, and metadata strategy to secure and organize enterprise data. Enroll today.
lede: Digital file plan design structures electronic records so they can be classified, found, secured, and managed throughout their lifecycle. This course is for records, information governance, and IT professionals responsible for digital information; it covers analyzing business workflows, building taxonomies and metadata schemas, configuring role- and attribute-based access controls, and developing retention, disposition, and audit processes.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals responsible for the integrity, security, and accessibility of corporate information assets in digital environments.
modules: Retention and Disposition in Digital Environments
prerequisites: Participants should have an intermediate understanding of organizational information workflows and basic familiarity with directory services (such as Active Directory). Experience managing shared drives or basic SharePoint environments is recommended. No prior programming knowledge is required, but a practitioner-level grasp of your organization's regulatory environment will enhance the workshop outcomes.
